changelog: Rename R12.5o's cumulative delivered work from `D` to `Y`, so `D` keeps its single meaning as the primary-purchase UTC date, and print R12.5n before R12.5o (§12.5).
File the twelve remaining `fcu_*` parameters under §12.5 in Appendix A, and state R12.5j's request cutoff as `fcu_acceptance_budget_ms` + `fcu_accepted_chunk_max_ms` instead of a 1,100 ms literal.
Add Appendix H.5 conformance rows for R12.5a–R12.5h, including the R12.5e serving bound (GAP).
Describe `agent_identity_min_stake` as reserved, not refundable: stake above the minimum can be withdrawn, and no path that releases the minimum itself is specified yet (§12.3, Appendix A).
Rename Proof of Useful Inference (PoUI) to Proof of Inference (PoI) in prose; parameter names keep `poui_*`.

Derive `channel_unconsented_reservation_tariff` as `floor(miner_capacity_stake_per_gflop × miner_stake_surge_multiplier_ppm / 10⁶)`, about 4.13e-8 FLOP per `G_n`, in place of 1 base unit. Describe the unsigned-open floor as a minimum capacity payment, not refundable collateral (D-0544; §7.1 R7.1f, Appendix A).

Bound miner-unsigned opens to `channel_max_unconsented_session_blocks` and require their escrow to cover the reserved allowance at `channel_unconsented_reservation_tariff`. Stop inherited over-reservation from blocking a non-shrinking renewal. Grandfather channels at their unchanged snapshot, and require a forward delivery rate to fit its channel's reservation (D-0543; §7.1 R7.1e/R7.1f, Appendices A and G).

Share each miner's calibration cap across its concurrent channels through per-channel capacity reservations, and cap SOFT calibration below the direct PoI proof floor (D-0542; §7.1 R7.1d/R7.1e, Appendix G.1, E.22).

Anchor the miner capacity-stake rate at 400,000 `G_n/s` per H100: `miner_capacity_stake_per_gflop` `VFY / 100` to `VFY / 30,240,000` per `G_n` of exposure, and §6.1 states the runtime formula (D-0541).
Raise `max_active_reservations_base` from 4 to 400 (D-0540).
Adopt validator set v2 (D-0539).

**Floor and selection.** Flat validator floor with no 9 %/yr growth (§15.2). Top-N stake-ranked equal seats re-selected each session with hysteresis and no forced rotation (§15.5). Each registered validator account occupies at most one active seat, and seats are equal, with no stake weight above the floor (R15.5).
**Committee.** Finality committee drawn uniformly from live seats with a late-revealed per-block VRF seed (§2.1 R2.4/R2.5, §15.4). Equal per-seat reward split with no committee premium (§9.1 R9.5).

**Rewards and unlock.** `validator_reward_bond_ppt` = 500 bonds and locks 50% of each seat's block-reward share and leaves 50% liquid, with every fee leg liquid (R9.13). Validator grant and bonded rewards unlock linearly from genesis over `validator_unlock_duration_blocks` (R8.7).

**Unbonding and slashing.** Validator unbonding, floor-guarded `unbond` and slash order (§15.7); AlephBFT fork and conflicting-justification rows (§11.3); uniform DA assignment (R5.3a); objective SLA evidence (R15.5c).
**Open stubs:** E.58–E.61. E.38 drops the Validator release order. The deprecated growth and premium parameters stay in Appendix A until they leave the runtime.

Index validator inference-fee legs through source-funded cumulative credits that never expire, in place of per-award integer floors (D-0545; R9.13). spec and canonical parameters (D-0529, D-0530, D-0531): set
Reconcile normative contradictions surfaced by the 2026-10-13 mirror sync: align §15.5, 10% churn cap while keeping the D-0507/D-0508/E.42 policy questions open; reconcile §9.3

Make the Era-T season length the testnet configuration value `era_t_season_blocks` (default and maximum 7,776,000 blocks). A ratified earlier snapshot may shorten the season; the three conversion pools stay fixed, and a shorter season moves nothing between cohorts (D-0547; §8.2 R8.5a).

Specify the FLOP Compute Unit (§12.5): integer six-decimal quantities, fractional holder lots and atomic FLOP resale (D-0534); fourteen UTC noon delivery starts (D-0536); a default-on primary admission pause (D-0537); and the service policy with a finalized SLA reserve (D-0538). Activation stays off.
Add the `content-v1` model identity, a root computed from published per-file SHA-256 tables, beside the dm-verity `verity-v1` root (D-0535; §3.3 R3.2a–R3.2d).

changelog: Ratify slot/tranche position rent (D-0524, R5.4e/f, E.54, F.7, G.4): replacements retain historical earned rent, failed or forfeited deltas refund the payer, and new tariffs use separate funded tranches. Supersede independent provider ceilings; add seven executable balance vectors.

Dispose implemented HTLC pair directions as target-only for initial publication (E.48, #1498). Preserve cross-leg late-claim, finality-stall and failed-payout counterexamples, qualify the local formal models, and add focused pallet/contract expiry-ordering tests and a reproducible pair gate.

Specify the Agent airdrop unlock as spend-to-unlock (R8.7, R8.8; D-0522). An Agent grant unlocks nothing at its start and has no end block; it unlocks one FLOP per three FLOP of its locked principal in the gross `payable` of settled sessions, once every fraud dispute raised in the window has resolved, and its locked compute spend is capped at three quarters of principal. Channel escrow drawn from locked principal goes to the `payable` first and is refunded first, back to the grant as frozen principal. E.38 no longer holds the Agent horizon.

Make current-profile channel settlements payment-only (R11.2b, task 1494). Receipt claims no longer feed public work rewards or performance vesting, including unilateral/DA-void payout. Historical recovery and future audited credit remain open; the distinct decision ID awaits approval.

Tighten the Appendix F vector schema to require canonical fields, byte widths, integer ranges, case identities, and coverage. Wide integers use decimal strings so JSON consumers preserve their exact values; the public generator also checks duplicate identities.

Replace §8.2's Miner and Validator airdrop unlock (R8.7, R8.8; D-0517). A Miner grant is a quarter liquid at its start and unlocks the rest one FLOP per FLOP it receives as miner from settled sessions once their dispute window passes, with no end block; block rewards earn no credit, and the performance adjustment is retired. A Validator grant stays frozen until the first halving, then grants release one per day without unbonding; none releases until E.38 fixes the order. Only Agent grants may still spend locked principal on compute; a miner may bond its locked principal as its own self-stake.

Make block rewards and the subsidy liquid on issue (R9.13; D-0518). The miner and validator legs and the Labs/Foundation subsidy are never auto-compounded, force-staked or vested, and agent-leg payouts are liquid once E.40 ratifies; validator earnings no longer auto-compound into locked stake, and E.39 is closed.
Ratify §8.2's grant-landing (R8.6) and claim and locked-spend (R8.8) rules as D-0515. D-0514 had covered only R8.3–R8.5 and R8.7; the requirement text is unchanged.
Repoint Appendix E blockers to live trackers and refresh Appendix H implementation grades for fee distribution, metering overflow, session-key invariants, and collusion monitoring.

Ratified D-0519 (owner, 2026-10-04): paid-storage service lanes close at a fixed boundary with a funding-pinned claim deadline on the finalized prefix. Only the lane's provider redeems, with strict sequence, counter and amount checks, including after reassignment. Otherwise-valid post-close signatures remain payable within the unspent budget until the deadline; finalization refunds only the remainder above it. Unknown finality rejects both operations. R5.4g, R5.4j, E.54, F.7 and G.4 carry the rule. E.54 constrains sequential entitlement-maturity and funded-request timing to fit that fixed dead

Era-T conversion and airdrop vesting (§8.2, R8.3–R8.8; D-0514). Conversion draws only on the fixed genesis cohort pools. Agents are scored on settled compute-channel spend and miners on verified effective-FLOP; balance, stake, job count and active days carry no weight. Snapshot and evidence of record are fixed before genesis lock. Grants land as frozen genesis balances with linear vesting and finalized-head claims. R5.4k now names R5.4q as its only exception; every other network is unchanged.
